exceptions.rationale: The affected package is a transitive dependency of the backend glob toolchain. The available fixed major line is not a safe forced override for the installed CommonJS parent. SalonAI runtime source is prohibited from directly importing brace-expansion, glob, or minimatch while the parent dependency upgrade is prepared.
controls: Release gate rejects expired or invalid exceptions

exceptions.rationale: The advisory affects unstable React Server Components APIs. SalonAI uses the declarative browser-router compatibility package and automated source scanning prohibits the affected unstable RSC APIs. react-router-dom 8.3.0 is not published, so a direct version substitution is invalid.
controls: Automated frontend source scan for unstable RSC APIs
Release gate rejects expired or invalid exceptions
